summary: Read Papineau pp.8-12 and notes 5-6 and certified a fork and an incompatible core between his causal premises and a q.75 per-se operation. Findings: the collective reading of his premise 3 gives only that some occurrence is based, and collectiveHybrid keeps a per-se operation; the core needs an unattributed basis/sharing bridge, without which bridgeExit keeps a reductive frame and a per-se operation. Rejected: labelling a fork branch with an author, since no eliminativist or nonreductivist witness was read; treating SomeUnbased as substance dualism or subsistence; building the bridge into a definition. Unresolved: every premise, Sturgeon's equivocation charge (note 6, not read beyond the note), consciousness, and intentionality. Any defense of the bridge or a q.75 reply remains open. See docs/notes/mind-physicalism-fork-419.md.
